Masala Milk
By: ravikumar
Published: Friday, December 22, 2017 - 9:52pm

Ingredients




1 cup milk
2-3 tbsp sugar
Half crushed almonds, pista and saffron (kesar)
Cardamom (elaichi) powder

Preparation

1 1. Boil 1 cup milk 2 2. Once the milk boils, add 2 tbsp sugar 3 3. Add cardamom powder according to taste 4 4. Add half crushed almonds, pista and kesar 5 5. Mix well and let the milk come to a boil 6 6. Pour into a cup 7 7. Masala milk is ready to serve

About

Delicious Masala Milk Recipe is a blend of nuts and aromatic spices, Masala Milk is a flavoured beverage made of milk with the mixture of aromatic Indian spices and herbs. Kesar masala Milk Recipe or Saffron Milk Shake Recipe contains a marvellous combination of health and refreshment.
